protocol: Every 7 days the selector picks — among trend / breakout / mean-reversion / ML-forecast strategies × parameters × leverage 2-10x × ATR stop/take-profit — the spec with the best lower confidence bound of daily log-growth over the previous 60 days (flat when no bound is positive); that spec trades the next fold. The folds are replayed as one $1000 account (15m bars, fees, slippage, funding, isolated liquidation), so the equity is entirely out-of-sample.
